reason: My customers buy from me because they know me and shake my hand at the fair, not because a stranger's email landed in their inbox. I might take the free list of 15 companies to see what you know, but I would not sign a pilot this month; at EUR 350 a meeting I can get a junior on the phone with Apollo for about the same money and keep it in-house.
objection: Your proof is one logistics client. In wholesale, a cold meeting with a buyer who has never heard of us usually ends in a price request and nothing else, so I doubt these meetings turn into orders, and I don't want an agency's cold emails going out with my name on them in a market where reputation is everything.
would_change_my_mind: A free list where most of the 15 companies are ones I don't already know and that really fit, plus a phone call with a wholesale or distribution owner like me who got actual orders, not just meetings, from you.
